H1: Reported political views will have an influence on a composite jealousy in relationships variable (jealousy about emotional infidelity, jealousy about sexual infidelity).
  IV: Political views
  DV: Jealousy in relationships composite score

H2: Reported financial prospects will have an influence on preferred long-term partner age.
  IV: Financial prospects
  DV: Preferred long-term partner age

```{r load data}

library(codebook)

raw <- read.csv("Data/raw/data_doctored.csv")

#make data with ID, and other target variables; keep raw unchanged
data <- raw[,c("ResponseId","self_resources","ideallt_age","jealemo","jealsex","cot_politics")]
```

```{r recode political views}

table(data$cot_politics,useNA="ifany")

data$cot_politics <- factor(data$cot_politics,
                         levels = c(1:5),
                         labels = c("Far Left","Center Left","Center","Center Right","Far Right"))
```

```{r replacing likert values w NA if outside range}

likert7 <- c("jealemo","jealsex")

likert11 <- c("self_resources","ideallt_age")

for(i in likert7){
  data[,i] <- ifelse(data[,i] %in% 1:7,data[,i],NA)
}

for(i in likert11){
  data[,i] <- ifelse(data[,i] %in% 1:11,data[,i],NA)
}

```

```{r create jealousy composite variable}

jeal <- c("jealemo","jealsex")

#calculate jealousy as the mean of both items
#for NAs, conduct available item mean

###JK: Please include this rule in your codebook description###

data$jealousy <- rowMeans(data[,c(jeal)], na.rm=TRUE)

```


```{r create H1 data}

h1 <- data[!is.na(data$cot_politics) & !is.na(data$jealousy),c("ResponseId","cot_politics","jealousy")]


```


```{r create H2 data}

h2 <- data[!is.na(data$self_resources) & !is.na(data$ideallt_age),c("ResponseId","self_resources","ideallt_age")]

```


```{r check variables}

dim(h1)
str(h1)
head(h1)
colSums(is.na(h1))
table(h1$cot_politics, useNA = "ifany")
range(h1$jealousy)
sum(duplicated(h1$ResponseId))

dim(h2)
str(h2)
head(h2)
colSums(is.na(h2))
range(h2$self_resources)
range(h2$ideallt_age)
sum(duplicated(h2$ResponseId))
```

```{r label variables}

var_label(h1) <- c("Participant ID",
                   "Self-Report Political Views (1-5; 1 = Far Left, 3 = Center, 5 = Far Right",
                   "Composite Jealousy Score Composed of Mean Jealousy of Emotional Infidelity and Jealousy of Sexual Infidelity (1-7; 1 = Not at all jealous, 4 = Moderately jealous, 7 = Extremely jealous")

var_label(h2) <- c(
  "Participant ID",
  "Self-reported financial prospects: 1=Very low, 6=Average, 11=Very high.",
  "Preferred long-term partner age group: 1=Under 20; 2=21-26; 3=27-32; 4=33-38; 5=39-44; 6=45-50; 7=51-56; 8=57-62; 9=63-68; 10=69-74; 11=Over 75."
 )

```


```{r make codebooks}

compact_codebook(h1)

compact_codebook(h2)

```


```{r save!}

dir.create("Data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(h1, "Data/processed/h1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(h2, "Data/processed/h2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
h1 <- read.csv("Data/processed/h1.csv")
h2 <- read.csv("Data/processed/h2.csv")
dim(h1)
dim(h2)

```
